scope: Identity, Authentication, Cookie Hardening, RBAC Matrix, Tenant Isolation, and Consent Baseline

jwt_tokens.cross_backend_parity: Strict parity enforced across Rust Gateway (backend-rust/) and Python (backend/) via shared claims contract and secret.

cookie_hardening.secure_mode: Auto-resolved to True in production; fails closed if overridden improperly.

commercial_slice_roles.partner: Authenticated cultural provider scoped to own provider_id / experiences / inquiries.
commercial_slice_roles.staff_editor: STAFF_ROLES (teacher, admin, super_admin) authorized for editorial content & artisan consent updates.

guest.content_access: Demo content only (is_demo=true). Blocked from non-demo motif unlock (403) and non-demo lesson completion (403).

learner.content_access: Full access to published lessons, motifs, quizzes, exams, progress, quests, achievements.
learner.admin_access: Blocked from admin settings and staff routes (403).

teacher.content_access: Learner capabilities plus create/edit draft lessons and manage classrooms.
teacher.super_admin_access: Blocked from user role mutation and system audit logs.

partner.inquiry_access: Strict provider ownership scoping. GET /api/v1/rbpc/partner/inquiries filters by provider_id. PATCH to other provider inquiry yields 403 FORBIDDEN_SCOPE.

admin.content_access: Full content approval, RAG configuration, analytics, feature flags, cross-provider inquiry oversight.

super_admin.system_access: Full system governance, audit log access, role alterations.

articles: Article 11: Valid data subject consent (voluntary, informed, affirmative, withdrawable).
Article 20: Child personal data protection (consent of child and parent/guardian required under 16).

regulatory_frameworks.controls: Parental consent, age verification, minimal data retention, zero PII disclosure.

regulatory_frameworks.scope: Living Masters and Traditional Artisans Consent
regulatory_frameworks.controls: Written display consent, non-commercial protections, immediate fail-closed upon revocation.

profile_visibility.enforcement: GET /api/v1/users/{id}/public checks 'if not user.is_profile_public and user.id != current_user.id: raise HTTPException(403, detail="Profile is private")'.
profile_visibility.leaderboard: Private profiles excluded from public discovery.

ai_personalization.description: User consent toggle for generative AI feedback and recommendations.

age_verification.purpose: Tracking age classification for minor/guardian compliance under Decree 13/2023/ND-CP.

fail_closed_behavior.public_creator_lookup: Returns 404 (RBPC_CREATOR_NOT_FOUND) when consent is pending_review or revoked.
fail_closed_behavior.public_experience_lookup: Returns 404 (RBPC_EXPERIENCE_NOT_FOUND) when creator consent is revoked.
fail_closed_behavior.booking_inquiry_creation: Returns 400 (RBPC_CREATOR_CONSENT_UNAVAILABLE) when creator consent is revoked.

audit_trail.features: Cryptographic previous_hash/new_hash chaining, actor attribution, recorded reason/proof_ref.

artisan_consent_controls.seed_preservation: backend/services/heritage_import.py strictly preserves revoked, pending_review, or verified_written_consent against default seed overwrites.

zero_pii_invariants.public_inquiry_tracking: GET /api/v1/rbpc/inquiries/status/{opaqueToken} returns public reference, experience title, status, date, and party size; excludes name, phone, email, and partner notes.
zero_pii_invariants.telemetry: RbpcEvent stores anonymous session IDs with consent_scope='telemetry_anonymous'.
zero_pii_invariants.inquiry_submission_opt_in: POST /api/v1/rbpc/inquiries requires explicit consent.accepted=True and consent.privacy_accepted=True.

verification.negative_test_evidence: Partner A get Partner B -> 403 FORBIDDEN_SCOPE verified. Inactive consent blocks public profile (403) and creator lookup (404) verified.

risks.description: Pre-existing disk space saturation (~98%) on production/dev host may slow batch DDL operations across concurrent processes.
risks.mitigation: Slot W00-A06 uses dedicated database (luuniensuki_t006) and non-dropping test fixture to avoid concurrent lock contention and disk churn.

risks.description: JWT iss/aud claim validation is currently in transition mode (jwt_validate_new_claims=False by default) to permit rolling zero-downtime deployment with Rust gateway.
risks.mitigation: Both backends issue the full claim set; once all nodes are deployed, setting JWT_VALIDATE_NEW_CLAIMS=True enables strict signature-level rejection of untrusted issuers.
